description: Muse-native agent-plane profile configuration. Phase M2 adds the model binding (model.primary references a model-registry entry — never a provider id) and provider transport; execution remains disabled until the Muse Agent Plane V0 exists. Phase M2.1 targets the Contributor-tier model officially published by Meta as muse-spark-1.3-contributor (contributor data-use terms: prompts and completions may train future Meta models — contributorProtection stays REQUIRED and dataUseTier stays contributor end to end). Reasoning is bounded by the Contributor tier's verified contract: official levels are minimal < low < medium < high < xhigh; the max level is Standard-tier muse-spark-1.3 only, and no explicit no-reasoning value exists (reasoning_effort none returns HTTP 400; omission means model-determined reasoning). xhigh is therefore the Contributor ceiling and doubles as the escalation bound.
